newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end firmer, focus on PI, Cimpor.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end firmer, focus on PI, Cimpor.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended firmer with pulp group Portucel Industrial the most heavily traded stock on Lisbon bourse. Dealers said cement group Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal should attract a lot of attention next week ahead of its partial privatisation.
* Other active stocks included constructor Engil-SGPS and computer firm Reditus. Dealers said investors were focusing on smaller stocks after the surge in blue chips in recent months.
* The firm trend in Reditus was due to its recent agreement with creditor banks, dealers said. Optimism over Engil's performance was aiding the stock.
* Portucel was well-supported around the 1,000 escudo level, operators said. A further rise in the share price will depend upon continuing evidence of a recovery in the pulp sector, they added.
